title: Who am I with in mallworld?
content: Looking for someone who recognizes some of my dream locations, and may experience the same feeling. I dream there pretty much every night. I am always with a group of 2-4 people, but I never actually look at their faces or recognize their voices. Do I have friends there that I don't know about in the waking world? (I am a loner irl, besides my bf) They are Typically behind me, going up the stairs to the water slide, or walking around a huge dimly lit indoor pool(the size of a football field), that always has people mingling around and in it. Sometimes we are in a huge grocery store, with wide aisles and everythjng you could ever imagine on the shelves, and its weirdly bright there, or trying to get up an escalator from the bottom floor of the mall, but cant seem to find it. sometimes we are driving around on a crazy roller coaster like highway. We will make our way to this rest stop looking area, it has a big store/warehouse in the next lot, and you loop around to a small strip of restaurants. Sometimes it's a BUSY McDonald's, other times it's an EMPTY mom and pop diner. If we leave from there, we keep going down the steep highway to a valley like area where there's a somewhat underground IKEA type store,? It's massive. Anyway back to the people. I will find myself asking them questions, but I never remember hearing them reply. It's like I just know what they're thinking. Most the time I don't feel scared, maybe a little anxious or like I'm in a rush. Anyone else experience this?
